design_philosophy: High-end, elite algorithmic trading. Think 'Black Card' or 'Bloomberg Terminal meets Rolex'. Extreme contrast, stark black backgrounds, metallic gold accents, and absolute precision in data display.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Marketing/Hero sections. Mode B (Control Room) for Performance Analytics.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. Container padding p-8 to p-12.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-white/10) heavily to separate grid items and create a 'Technical' look. No soft rounded corners; use rounded-none or max rounded-sm.

components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-[#050505]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Must contain a live blinking ticker in JetBrains Mono.
components.buttons: Sharp edges. Primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-medium hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:border-[#D4AF37].
components.cards: Flat background (#0C0C0C), 1px solid border (border-white/10), no shadows. Instead of shadow, use an inner 1px border or subtle noise texture.
components.charts: Recharts. Remove standard axes and grid lines. Use single vibrant gold line (#D4AF37) on #050505 background. Tooltips must have sharp borders and monospace font.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for the broker partner section. Editorial ribbon style: Low contrast, huge monospace or sans-serif text, slow drift.

hero_texture_bg.description: Deep dark rippling texture. Set to 10-15% opacity behind the hero section to kill digital flatness.

performance_visual.description: Trading chart close up. Use in the 'How It Works' or 'Analytics' section, overlaid with a black/gold gradient.

gold_accent_texture.description: Crumpled gold fabric. Use extremely sparingly as a mask-image or blend-mode overlay on premium badges/icons.

media_and_assets.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Light) for a premium, delicate technical feel. @phosphor-icons/react.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layouts; avoid rigid Shadcn section wrappers to allow asymmetric bento grids.
Use Shadcn for interactive logic (accordions, tabs, form inputs) but strip the default Vercel aesthetic. Override radii to 0px and change focus rings to gold.
For logos (Trade.com, Paystack, MT5), construct them using pure Typography + Phosphor Icons (e.g., <ChartLineUp/> TRADE.COM) rather than fetching generic images, to keep the luxury aesthetic intact.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, accordion triggers, and form inputs.
Install and use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Chart aesthetics: Data is the art. Give charts plenty of negative space. No clutter. Recharts must use a transparent background with #D4AF37 strokes.
In the Purchase section, use the 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border effect on the pricing card.
